study: 十板块评分策略：减少连带调仓与小额订单实验
status: Rules frozen before any new A/B performance run; history already seen in earlier studies, not unseen out-of-sample.
unchanged: Raw data, causal TRIX12/9, economic price-volume scores and four 25% components
SCORE weights .20*score/100 on eligible funds, otherwise zero; MATCH equal splits same sum; targets capped .20
Cash accounting, real corporate actions, 100-share lots, next-open adverse fills and no leverage
No probability, fundamentals, news, market filter or score optimization

execution_A.scheduled: Initialization and decision-date Friday: reassess all eligible positions to original targets. Friday means actual Friday, not a replacement last trading day before a Friday holiday.
execution_A.other_days: Only exit currently held ineligible funds and enter newly eligible funds that currently have zero shares. Do not resize other holdings. Detect current ineligible holdings every allowed day, including a retry after missing execution quotes.
execution_A.entry_failure: Entry is attempted on initialization, new-eligibility event, or Friday. Any missing/insufficient-cash/partial entry is reconsidered only at next Friday or a new eligibility event; no daily top-up.
execution_A.exit_failure: If open is absent/nonpositive or day amount nonpositive defer. Retry daily while signal remains ineligible. If eligibility recovers before executable exit, cancel exit and keep current shares.
execution_A.cash: Sell allowed orders first. All buys use simultaneous proportional budgets including fees; no code-order priority. Leftover cash stays cash. Never sell valid incumbents on an event-only day to fund an entrant.
execution_A.timing: Known NAV and decision weights are exact Decimal decision-date closing NAV/security values, or capital/zero holdings before inception. Corporate actions occur before open, with delayed dividends according to unchanged original engine. Quantity uses executable open, never its closing price.
execution_A.delay: delay=2 uses two-market-day-old signal, eligibility comparison, Friday date, known NAV and known decision weights; first day remains uninvested, matching original convention.

execution_B.applies: Only scheduled Friday optional resizing of currently held, TRIX-eligible positions, including score-zero reductions. Existing-position classification uses actual pre-execution shares. Initialization, zero-position entries and mandatory ineligible exits are exempt.
execution_B.band: Absolute target minus exact decision-close position weight >= 0.02 of whole-account NAV. Equality passes. This is 2 percentage points of NAV, not 2% of target.
execution_B.notional: After rounding to lots, sell order amount or final cash-budgeted buy amount at its adverse execution price must be >=5000 yuan. Equality passes. Below threshold means cancel entire optional order.
execution_B.order: Filter optional sells before computing available cash. Filter buys by band before proportional budgeting; after budgeting filter buy notional. Freed cash from rejected buys remains cash, no redistribution/rebudget loop.
execution_B.rationale: Simple predeclared execution controls, not an estimated alpha/cost break-even. 5000 makes the assumed 5 yuan commission 0.1% one-way before slippage. Neither number has been optimized or shown economically optimal.
execution_B.stress: The same 0.02 and 5000 apply in every scenario, including double cost and zero minimum commission.

evaluation: Net CAGR, marked terminal NAV, max drawdown, actual average exposure and top3 concentration
Trades, commissions, modeled slippage, turnover, optional rejected orders, industry profit contribution
Same-execution SCORE versus equal target total allocation; actual exposure may differ due to drift/gates/cash
Report every prespecified result; do not retune after seeing returns; cost and position changes are not additive causal effects
limits: About 2.50 years common score evaluation, not ten years; frozen data ends September 30
Surviving fixed ETF pool; already observed history; thresholds inspired by prior diagnosis
Minimum 5 yuan commission not confirmed for users broker; zero-minimum scenario is conditional, not a claim about real charges
Next open sell/buy availability and ticks modeled on daily bars, not demonstrated real fills; no new turnover capacity cap
Target20% may be exceeded by actual drift; Friday holiday skips scheduled review
Old corporate-action evidence and source revision limits retained; no probability refit or improved probability claim
No app integration, real-account operation, cloud deployment or live monitoring
